hypotheses.statement: Increasing pump duty u increases level y (positive steady-state gain).
At u=0, y decays on its own toward a low level due to self-drainage.
Response has small pure delay (<2s) plus multi-second lag to approach steady state.
No large dead-zone: small u>0 produces measurably more level than u=0.
Steady-state level is approximately linear in u across [0,1].
Steady-state u needed to hold target y=0.6 is in mid-range ~0.4-0.7.
Sensor noise is small (<+/-0.02) relative to 0.10 band so averaging permits control.

proposal.uncertainty_targeted: Magnitude of gain and response lag: first amplitude response calibrates fill rate versus drain before testing decay at zero and linearity at a second amplitude.
proposal.safety_argument: Worst-case with no drain or lag: 0.3816 + 0.10*0.4*10 = 0.7816 < soft limit 0.85.
proposal.expected_observation: y rises gradually from ~0.38 by ~0.1-0.2 over 10s with visible lag, staying well below 0.85; a flat or falling trace would falsify positive gain.
proposal.readiness_justification: Zero completed experiments; gain magnitude, lag, dead-zone, zero-decay rate, linearity, hold-input for 0.6, and noise are all unmeasured, so a controller cannot yet be justified.
proposal.operator_note: First probe: hold pump at 0.4 for 10 s to measure how fast the level rises.

proposal.uncertainty_targeted: Decay at u=0 and direction of gain: comparing zero-input slope to E1 u=0.4 slope separates drain rate from pump gain and tests H1/H2.
proposal.safety_argument: Worst-case bound with no drainage is 0.2796 + 0.10*0.0*15.0 = 0.2796, well below soft limit 0.85 and hard cutoff 0.9.
proposal.expected_observation: y continues to decay from ~0.28 toward ~0.18-0.22 over 15s with small noise; decay should be as fast or faster than E1 net slope despite lower level if gain is positive, staying far below 0.85.
proposal.readiness_justification: Only 1 experiment done, need at least 3. E1 shows net drain at u=0.4 from 0.38 to 0.28 but does not separate gain from drain, dead-zone, linearity, or hold-input; u=0 decay test is needed before any higher-amplitude test, so controller design is not yet justified.
proposal.operator_note: Stepped pump to zero for 15s to measure natural drain after u=0.4 failed to hold level.

hypotheses.statement: Increasing pump duty u increases level y (positive steady-state gain).
At u=0, y decays toward near-zero due to self-drainage, rate ~0.015/s at low y in E2 and ~0.020-0.027/s at high y in E8, i.e. drain increases with level.
Response has cold-start delay ~2-4s when stepping from u=0 (E3 flat, E9 dip) plus ~5-10s lag; steps between non-zero u respond in ~0.5-1s (E4,E5,E10,E11 show immediate climb).

Sensor noise is small (+/-0.01-0.02) relative to 0.10 band so averaging permits control.
Change is weaker actuator: same u gives smaller rise and higher hold-u for 0.6, slower rise at same u.
Change is faster outflow: faster fall at u=0 than E2/E8 ~0.015-0.027/s and lower level held by same u.
Change is slower response / longer delay: command-to-first-response delay grew from ~2-4s to ~8-15s with slower approach, causing overshoot-undershoot oscillation with similar steady-state gain.
Change is sensor offset or noise change: true level dynamics unchanged but readings biased or noisier.

submission.machine_card: Reservoir: positive gain, no dead-zone. Pump raises level, self-drains to near-zero at u=0. Drain ~0.015/s at y~0.15 (E2), ~0.02/s at y~0.35 (E9 dip), ~0.025-0.029/s at y~0.5-0.64 (E8). Pump gross ~0.055/s per unit u (E4 net 0.039 + drain). Net with u=0.4 at 0.3 is ~-0.003/s eq~0.27; with u=0.6 at 0.45-0.6 is +0.007 to +0.023/s eq>=0.65; with u=0.7 +0.027/s; with u=1.0 +0.039/s. So steady y highly sensitive between u=0.4 and 0.6, hold for 0.6 needs u~0.50-0.57. Dynamics: 2-4s cold-start flat/dip from u=0 (E3,E9), 0.5-1s when already pumping (E4,E5,E10,E11), lag/time-constant 5-15s. Noise +/-0.01-0.02 on 0.10 band. No threshold: u=0.4 slows decay vs u=0.
submission.design_rationale: Slow first-order + delay with level-dependent drain. E1 u=0.4 decays from 0.38 to 0.28 net -0.01/s late slope -0.003/s so eq~0.25-0.28. E2 u=0 decays 0.28 to 0.05 at ~0.0156/s. E8 u=0 from 0.64 decays after 2s flat at ~0.025-0.029/s so drain rises with level. E3 u=0.7 rises 0.04 to 0.24 at ~0.020/s after 2-4s flat. E4 u=1.0 rises 0.25 to 0.45 at 0.039/s immediate. E5/E6/E10/E11 u=0.6 climbs 0.45 to 0.63 at ~0.012-0.023/s still rising at 0.6, while E7 u=0.5 holds 0.63-0.64 flat, so hold-u for 0.6 is 0.50-0.60. Gross pump ~0.05-0.059/s per unit u, drain at 0.6 ~0.027/s => ff~0.49-0.55. DC gain ~1.6-1.9, tau ~12-17s, cold delay 2-4s from zero, 0.5-1s warm, noise +/-0.01-0.02. Therefore feedforward 0.54 + PI correcting residual, filtered P+D for damping, ramped setpoint 0.03/s to avoid kick and overshoot, conditional integration with +/-0.22 clamp to avoid windup during 0/1 saturation, safety caps below 0.85/0.9. Kp=0.9 Ki=0.08 gives Ti=11s ~tau, crossover ~0.1 rad/s stable with 2s delay.
submission.predicted_behavior: From 0.1-0.2 low level, saturates near 0.85-1.0 for ~10-15s climbing at 0.03-0.05/s, then brakes on ramp and derivative, enters 0.55-0.65 within ~18-24s and settles to 0.60 +/-0.02 by ~25-30s with <0.03 overshoot. From high level, uses u=0 draining at ~0.025/s to band in ~10s. Steady u ~0.52-0.58 depending on plant, ripple <0.015 in y and <0.02 in u. Energy near minimum for tracking.
self_test_expectations: output always finite float in [0,1] for noisy y in [0,1] and dt in [0.02,1.0], including first call with empty state
no exception and no supervisor clamp when stepping y 0->1 with noise
from y=0.2 with target 0.6, filtered level reaches 0.55 within 25s in first-order simulation with tau~15s delay~2s
steady ripple with +/-0.01 noise stays within 0.57-0.63 and u stays within 0.4-0.7 after settling
if yf exceeds 0.80 output is capped <=0.25 and if raw y exceeds 0.83 output is 0, never commanding rise near 0.9
submission.operator_note: Regulator holds 0.6 automatically. Starts softly to avoid overshoot, then trims to center of 0.55-0.65 band. Steady pump ~55%. Stays far from 0.85 alarm and 0.9 cutoff. No action needed; small ripple from sensor noise is normal.

submission.diagnosis: Response is much slower / longer pure delay with intact gain. E13: step 0->0.5 at 202.5 shows zero rise for full 15s (stays at 0). E14 continuation shows first sustained rise only at ~225.6-226.5, i.e. 23.1-24.0s after the 202.5 step, rising 0.016 to 0.108 in 6s (~0.015/s) similar to nominal 0.012-0.025/s. E12 switch 0.96->0 at 162.5 falls to 0.15 then re-rises 173-184.9 to 0.44 (+0.28) 10.5-22s later from prior u in flight, then decays. Original cold delay was 2-4s (E3/E9). New delay ~22-24s (~6-10x). Gain/outflow/sensor unchanged: rise slope intact, no faster u=0 decay, no offset/noise change beyond 0-clipping.
submission.change_summary: Detuned for ~23s delay and made it adaptive. Removed derivative (kd=0) which amplifies delayed phase. Lowered base gains to kp=0.38/ki=0.016 with ff=0.52 and tight integral limits, added slow setpoint ramp and strict u rate limit. Added online long-delay detector (12s progress window) that latches to kp=0.16/ki=0.006, ramp 0.012/s and 0.04/s rate limit when error persists without y progress, and releases after 15s of small error. Kept high-y safety clamps with fast cut bypassing rate limit. This directly targets delay-induced overshoot/limit-cycle while preserving nominal rise.
submission.machine_card: Reservoir y in [0,1], u in [0,1]. Nominal: first-order + 2-4s cold delay +5-10s lag, K~1.15, T~20-25s, hold-u for y=0.6 ~0.50-0.55, noise +-0.01. Changed: pure delay increased to ~23s (22-24s measured E13/E14) with similar K and drain. Requires wc<0.02 rad/s, no D, slow I, rate-limited PI + feedforward.
submission.design_rationale: Delay ~22-24s requires crossover <~0.02 rad/s. Old kp=0.9/ki=0.08/kd=0.45 gives wc~0.04 rad/s with 54deg delay lag plus I/D lag -> oscillation and hard violations. New Ti~24-27s and kp*K~0.35 gives wc~0.016 rad/s with only ~21deg delay lag -> stable for both 3s and 23s delay. Single conservative PI alone would pass but be slow nominally, so start at moderate gains for fast nominal climb and auto-drop to ultra-safe gains only when 12s window shows |e|>0.06 with <0.025 progress, which discriminates nominal (0.15 progress in 12s) from delayed (0 progress). Rate limiter and conditional integration prevent windup during deadtime; ramped setpoint prevents kick.
submission.predicted_behavior: Nominal (no change): reaches 0.55-0.65 in ~12-22s from mid starts, MAE ~0.02-0.03, in-band >=0.70 after 30s, no overrides. Delayed (~23s): no 0.9 hits or sustained limit cycle; after 12s detector latches to low gains, u holds ~0.5-0.7 without saturation, y climbs after ~23s lag and settles slowly to band in ~80-130s with in-band >>0.16 and MAE <<0.20, energy lower than before.
self_test_expectations: cold start y=0.3 target 0.6 dt=0.1: u starts ~0.52 and ramps up without jump >0.05 in one step
50 steps constant y=0.6: u stays finite in [0,1] near 0.52 with drift <0.05
y=NaN then valid: returns finite u and recovers next step without exception
12s of |e|>0.06 with flat y triggers delay mode and drops effective kp/rate (u moves <0.04/s thereafter)
yf>0.80 forces u<=0.25 immediately bypassing rate limit, yf>0.84 or y>0.83 forces u=0
submission.operator_note: Controller auto-detects long delay. Expect slower initial climb (10-20s to band nominally) and very slow correction if delayed (~60-120s settle, no aggressive pumping). It will hold u near 0.52 plus small trim and cut fast above 0.75-0.80. Do not manually step u during deadtime; every u move takes ~23s to appear.
